newsitem.title: USA: Waste cuts 1997 EPS estimate to $1.65.
newsitem.headline: Waste cuts 1997 EPS estimate to $1.65.

text.p: Waste Management Inc said Tusday it lowered its guidance on 1997 earnings per share to an estimate of $1.65 per share, excluding the effect of a special charge, from $1.75 per share.
On second-quarter results reported Tuesday, the company said, "While the company has expected revenue and earnings to be flat in the quarter, these results are below our expectations."
The company reported second-quarter net income of $180 million, down from year-ago net income of $223 million. Revenues for the quarter were $2.33 billion, even with $2.33 billion a year ago.
